description: This file contains unit tests for the ToolDisplayRegistry component within the OpenClawKit project. It verifies the loading of a tool display configuration and resolving known tools from configuration.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistryTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the functionality of the ToolDisplayRegistry component.

methods.name: loadsToolDisplayConfigFromBundle
methods.description: Tests if the tool display configuration JSON file can be loaded from the app bundle.

methods.name: resolvesKnownToolFromConfig
methods.description: Tests if a known tool can be correctly resolved from the configuration.
